clauses.quote: The employee must furnish evidence that all of the degree requirements have been met.
Initial micro-credentials credits, issued by the USBE and NEA, will be accepted for lane change credit.
clauses.subject_text: Initial micro-credentials credits, issued by the USBE and NEA

clauses.quote: Application for lane advancement on the salary schedule must be made on the official form provided by the Human Resources office (see Appendix C.)
clauses.subject_text: Application for lane advancement on the salary schedule

clauses.quote: Applications must be supported by complete official transcripts of credit (report cards will not suffice), verifying the credit requested.
Lane change will become effective on the date the completed application form, and all official documentation forms, are received by the Human Resources office.
The lane change will be made on the next payroll cutoff date
the salary increase will be reflected on the paycheck following that payroll cutoff date

The total amount paid for the year from the new lane will be prorated based upon the number of contract working days remaining as of the date when all necessary materials are received by the Human Resources office.
clauses.subject_text: The total amount paid for the year from the new lane

clauses.quote: Prior Approval credit may be used toward lane advancement on the salary schedule.
Prior Approval forms must be submitted and approved prior to the professional learning activity.
All USBE approved professional learning credit will count towards lane change.
clauses.subject_text: All USBE approved professional learning credit

clauses.quote: USBE and NEA initial micro-credentials credits will count towards lane change.
clauses.subject_text: USBE and NEA initial micro-credentials credits

clauses.quote: Evidence of credit (e.g. transcripts, USBE report, Prior Approval form, etc.) is to be submitted to Human Resources
clauses.subject_text: Evidence of credit (e.g. transcripts, USBE report, Prior Approval form, etc.)
